text:
devbot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx and timeouts on /v1/paged-stream endpoints across gateway-us-west and gateway-eu. streaming disconnect rate +client-cancel rate up ~12% in last 5m. paging fanout latencies climbing. paging-error-rate: 5xx=9.7% (baseline 0.4%)

oliver-oncall: I'm on it. switching to on-call runbook 'streaming-fanout-5xx'. tagging SRE and Platform. @maya-sre @liam-platform can you join?

maya-sre: joining. seeing repeated `504 upstream read timeout` and `chunked encoding: unexpected EOF` from gateway logs. lots of partial frames from clients.

liam-platform: I'm seeing the same at the ingress LB: connection spikes, keepalive resets. Many concurrent long-lived streaming connections from a single customer IP block (x.x.x.x/22). Could be aggressive client fanout.

sara-support: P0 support queue, two customers reported chat dropouts. one on EU region. Customer impact: degraded streaming reliability; some responses truncated. CS ticket #INC-7343.

nish-ml: model-serving looks healthy (p99 latency normal), KV cache hit rate unchanged. This smells like gateway/fanout aggregation / proxy backpressure rather than model slowness.

oliver-oncall: mitigation steps: 1) apply short-term throttling by IP for suspected CIDR, 2) reduce paging fanout concurrency from 8->3, 3) bump gateway upstream timeout to 75s from 60s to tolerate slow clients, 4) enable streaming fallback route to small-batch variant. I'll run commands now.

harper-ops: before throttling, push an allowlist for internal monitoring to avoid self-throttling. Also capture tcpdump on one problematic gateway host.

oliver-oncall: running throttle: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/ratelimit -d '{"cidr":"x.x.x.x/22","limit":20}'`

incident-bot: NOTE: Throttle rule created by oliver-oncall at 2117770020. Rule id rl-7421.

liam-platform: reducing fanout concurrency in config service: `PATCH /config/paged/fanout {"concurrency":3}` -> applied on canary hosts.

maya-sre: canary metrics look promising: streaming disconnects down 40% on canary. 5xx trending down. Applying rollout to all gateways over 5m.

nish-ml: enabling fallback small-batch model route for requests that hit chunked encode failures: `route-match: chunked-fallback -> model-small-v1`

oliver-oncall: bumped upstream timeouts on gateway group gw-us-west: `nginx.conf: proxy_read_timeout 75s` and reloaded. watch for memory/conn usage.

harper-ops: capturing pcap and saved to s3://redwood-ops/pcaps/2117770000-gw1.pcap for postmortem.

sara-support: updating affected customers: ticket notes with mitigation steps + ETA for full resolution.

liam-platform: quick note: we saw one recent deploy to gateway image tag `gw-2.14.1` ~30m before spike. rolling back to `gw-2.14.0` on one host to test.

oliver-oncall: rollback on single host observed no immediate improvement; suggests config + client behavior. continuing with throttles and concurrency limits.

maya-sre: live metrics: 5xx dropped to 2.1% after throttling+fanout limit; streaming disconnects down to 3.5% from 12%. p95 latency slightly improved. still watching for reoccurrence.

nish-ml: capturing sample truncated payloads and client headers for correlated analysis. looks like some clients are closing connections mid-chunk when receiving NACKs from intermediate proxies.

harper-ops: temporary mitigation complete. recommend follow-ups: 1) implement per-customer streaming concurrency guard in gateway, 2) add better chunked-encoding retry at the proxy, 3) alert on single IP fanout anomalies, 4) postmortem and CS outreach plan.

oliver-oncall: agreed. I'm handing off to SRE lead for postmortem and to platform for hardening work. Handoff to @maya-sre at 2117770600.

incident-bot: ON-CALL HANDOFF: oliver-oncall -> maya-sre at 2117770600. Incident state: mitigated (partial). Tickets: INC-7343, RL-7421.

maya-sre: taking over. will schedule postmortem, include pcap + config diffs + customer traces. tagging @nish-ml for payload analysis.

sara-support: marking customer impact: intermittent stream truncation for ~40 customers across regions. Noted in billing-impact audit: none.

oliver-oncall: thanks everyone. leaving a short runbook note in #runbooks/streaming-fanout with quick commands used. :thumbsup:

maya-sre: closing live mitigation thread; if metrics re-spike we'll reopen.

devbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) at 2117770875. Final status: throttles + concurrency limits reduced 5xx to baseline, further platform hardening required.
